provenance.reason: The preserved r2 completion record reported nine SRT display cues longer than eight seconds. V3 freezes a display-only split inside each measured sentence interval without changing narration, TTS, segment audio, or the original sentence cues used by P0 semantic timing.
provenance.platform_requirement: Windows with an enabled zh-CN System.Speech voice

storage_policy: Generated audio, sentence cues, subtitles and runtime hash manifests stay in the ignored run bundle; audio and video binaries are not committed to Git.
